title: Python Developer
description: Harness the versatility of Python for modern web backends, automated data pipelines, asynchronous APIs, and cloud services using FastAPI, Django, and Celery.

goal.objective: Build high-velocity web services, asynchronous REST/gRPC APIs, data pipelines, and automation engines powered by modern Python standards.

learn.summary: Master modern Python 3.12, type hinting, asynchronous programming (asyncio), FastAPI, Django, SQLAlchemy, Celery background workers, and automated testing with pytest.

capstone_projects.title: High-Concurrency Asynchronous Web Scraping & Ingestion Engine
capstone_projects.description: Engineer an asynchronous scraping engine capable of harvesting and parsing 5,000 dynamic web pages per minute with distributed rate limiting and proxies.

capstone_projects.title: Production REST API Microservice with FastAPI & Event-Driven Celery
capstone_projects.description: Construct an asynchronous enterprise API backend featuring clean architecture, background Celery task queues, Redis caching, and full integration test coverage.

certifications: PCEP & PCAP Certified Associate in Python Programming
interview_focus: Python Memory Management, Reference Counting & Generational Garbage Collection
The Global Interpreter Lock (GIL), Free-Threading (PEP 703) & Multiprocessing vs Asyncio
Decorators, Context Managers (__enter__ / __exit__) & Metaclasses in Python
Advanced Asyncio (Event Loop Mechanics, Tasks, Futures, Gathering vs As Completed)
Python Performance Profiling (cProfile, memory_profiler, Cython & Vectorization with NumPy)

tree.name: Python Fundamentals & Development Environment
tree.description: Establish an uncompromising modern Python foundation (Python 3.12+): master CPython runtime internals, memory allocation and garbage collection, the Global Interpreter Lock (GIL), asynchronous event loops, and modern package management.

resources.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python
PEP 8 – Style Guide for Python Code
Python Tutorial for Beginners — Full Course
Python for Beginners – Full Course — freeCodeCamp

children.name: Python Core Language & Paradigms
children.description: Deep dive into CPython runtime internals and advanced language mechanics: object model and memory overhead (everything is a PyObject), reference counting and cyclic garbage collection generations, bytecode inspection with the `dis` module, iterators and generators (`yield from`), context managers (`__enter__`, `__exit__`), decorators with `functools.wraps`, descriptor protocol (`__get__`, `__set__`), metaclasses, modern static typing (TypeVar, ParamSpec, Protocol for structural subtyping), and `asyncio` event loop task scheduling.

children.name: Development Environment & Tooling
children.description: Master the high-performance modern Python tooling ecosystem: lightning-fast package resolution and virtual environment management with `uv` and `Poetry`, unified configuration in `pyproject.toml`, linting and formatting with `Ruff` (replacing Black, Flake8, and isort), strict static type analysis with `Mypy` (`--strict` mode), and pre-commit hooks enforcing repository standards.

resources.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Python! - Development Environments
Python Virtual Environments Tutorial — Corey Schafer
Git and GitHub for Beginners — freeCodeCamp

children.name: Data Structures & Algorithms (Basics)
children.description: Master Python algorithmic efficiency: Big-O analysis of built-in types (lists dynamic array amortized resizing, dictionaries and sets compact hash table implementation with open addressing), double-ended queues (`collections.deque` O(1) append/pop), priority heaps with `heapq`, binary search optimization with `bisect`, and implementing custom graph, tree, and dynamic programming algorithms.

resources.title: Data Structures and Algorithms in Python — freeCodeCamp

tree.name: Backend Web Development with Python
tree.description: Engineer production-grade asynchronous web services and APIs: high-performance ASGI frameworks, relational database persistence, eager loading, and defense-in-depth API security.

resources.title: Python Backend Web Development Course — freeCodeCamp
Python API Development — Full Course — freeCodeCamp

children.name: Web Frameworks & API Design (FastAPI / Django)
children.description: Build enterprise web APIs using FastAPI and modern Django: FastAPI with Pydantic v2 (Rust-backed data validation and serialization), ASGI servers (Uvicorn running on `uvloop`), asynchronous dependency injection (`Depends`), request lifecycle middleware, background tasks, and Django 5 with async views, signals, and production ORM optimization.

resources.title: Building a RESTful API with Django REST Framework
Django For Beginners — Full Tutorial — Tech With Tim

children.name: Database Management & ORMs
children.description: Master enterprise database engineering with SQLAlchemy 2.0: async engine configuration (`create_async_engine`), declarative mapped models, tuning connection pools (`QueuePool` sizing and recycling), diagnosing and eliminating the N+1 query problem using explicit loading strategies (`selectinload` for one-to-many, `joinedload` for many-to-one), ACID transaction management with savepoints, database migrations with Alembic, and distributed caching with Redis.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial — Full Database Course — freeCodeCamp

children.name: API Security & Best Practices
children.description: Implement robust backend API security: OAuth2 with Password, Authorization Code, and Client Credentials flows, JWT token issuance and validation (access and refresh tokens with RS256 cryptography), Argon2id password hashing, distributed rate limiting with Redis token buckets, strict CORS and CSRF defense, SQL injection elimination via parameterized ORM queries, and secret management using environment variables.

resources.title: JWT Authentication in Python — Tech With Tim

tree.name: Automation, Testing & DevOps Fundamentals
tree.description: Enforce automated quality assurance and distributed background job processing: test pyramids, asynchronous test suites, message queues, and full-stack observability.

resources.title: DevOps Engineering Course for Beginners — freeCodeCamp

children.name: Automated Testing & Quality Assurance
children.description: Implement rigorous testing with `pytest`: fixture scope hierarchies (session, module, function) and dependency injection, parameterized test matrices (`@pytest.mark.parametrize`), testing async coroutines with `pytest-asyncio`, mocking external services with `unittest.mock` (enforcing `autospec=True` to prevent mock drift), measuring code coverage with `pytest-cov`, and spinning up real PostgreSQL and Redis containers with `testcontainers-python`.

children.name: Continuous Integration & Deployment (CI/CD)
children.description: Build automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions: running Ruff formatting and lint checks, executing Mypy type verification, running parallel pytest matrices across Python versions, security vulnerability scanning with Bandit and Safety, and automated container image builds.

resources.title: GitHub Actions Tutorial — TechWorld with Nana

children.name: Scripting, Task Management & Automation
children.description: Master distributed background processing and task automation: Celery with Redis or RabbitMQ as the message broker, designing idempotent tasks, handling task retries with exponential backoff and jitter, orchestrating complex task graphs with Celery Canvas (signatures, groups, chains, chords), scheduled cron jobs with Celery Beat, and building ergonomic command-line tools using `Click` or `Typer`.

resources.title: Automate with Python — Full Course — freeCodeCamp

children.name: Observability: Logging, Monitoring & Tracing
children.description: Implement production-grade observability: structured JSON logging with `structlog`, gathering Prometheus metrics (`prometheus_client`) for request throughput, latency histograms, and error rates, distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry (OTel) auto-instrumentation and custom spans, and real-time error tracking with Sentry.

resources.title: Prometheus & Grafana Tutorial — TechWorld with Nana

tree.name: Deployment, Cloud & Advanced Project
tree.description: Deploy, scale, and operate production Python systems: container optimization, cloud infrastructure, high-availability system architecture, and capstone engineering.

resources.title: DevOps Crash Course (Docker, Terraform, and Github Actions) (Traversy Media)

children.name: Containerization with Docker
children.description: Master Docker containerization for Python: writing optimized multi-stage Dockerfiles, leveraging layer caching, running as an unprivileged non-root user, tuning production WSGI/ASGI worker counts (`(2 * CPU cores) + 1`), configuring health checks, and orchestrating multi-container development environments with Docker Compose.

resources.title: Docker Tutorial for Beginners — TechWorld with Nana

children.name: Cloud Deployment & Infrastructure
children.description: Deploy and scale Python applications on cloud platforms: AWS ECS Fargate or Google Cloud Run, configuring managed databases (RDS PostgreSQL) with VPC private subnets, managing secrets via AWS Secrets Manager / GCP Secret Manager, and provisioning cloud resources declaratively using Terraform.

children.name: System Design & Scalability Basics
children.description: Architect resilient, scalable distributed systems: load balancing with NGINX, reverse proxies and API gateways, horizontal scaling stateless services, message queues for asynchronous decoupling, Redis cache-aside caching to prevent database overload, database read replicas with connection routing, and disaster recovery strategies.

resources.title: System Design Concepts Course and Interview Prep (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Final Project: Production-Ready Backend Service
children.description: Capstone: Architect, build, and deploy an enterprise-grade, asynchronous real-time e-commerce order processing and analytics platform in Python 3.12: FastAPI async backend, PostgreSQL database with SQLAlchemy 2.0 and Alembic migrations, Redis caching and distributed locks, Celery worker cluster for order fulfillment and PDF invoice generation, full test suite with Pytest and Testcontainers, structured logging with Structlog, and containerized Kubernetes deployment manifests.

resources.title: Build & Deploy a Python API — Traversy Media
